title: Signal Sync playbook and asset gating for timed announcements
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook that centralizes timing decisions (signals) for cross-channel announcements and gates asset publication until approval windows pass. The goal is to remove ad-hoc timing mistakes, enable safe last-minute changes, and provide a single source of truth for blog, email, social, and webinar assets. This ticket covers coordination rules, ownership matrix, gated publish checklist, and a lightweight automation requirement spec for the scheduling tool.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook drafted and reviewed by PM/Design/Eng leads
Stakeholder roster and escalation path documented
Publish gating checklist implemented as a Google Sheet template and linked in the playbook
Minimum viable automation spec (webhook + gating states) uploaded to the engineering backlog as ENG-xxxx
Dry-run simulation of a staged announcement completed with attendees from comms, growth, and support
